fact: On 29 September 2023 the DGSN announced it would contract a provider on a Build-Operate-Transfer basis to produce biometric ID cards, the existing system being run by Thales since 2017 and delivering delays of up to four years.
title: Après l'échec du français Thalès, le gouvernement recherche un nouveau prestataire pour la production des cartes d'identité biométriques
